lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Arranged in a series of six distinct horizontal rows and approximately fifteen vertical columns extending posteriorly from the fifth gill slit, forming a structured grid-like matrix of high-luminance local maxima.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the primary circular blobs, functioning as vertical anchor lines within the mid-lateral grid pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature is visible on the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient from high-intensity dorsal pixels to low-intensity ventral shadow pixels, extending from the gill region toward the caudal peduncle.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin macro-mask contains approximately 15 to 20 high-luminance blobs distributed in a semi-ordered fashion, primarily aligned with the vertical columns of the lateral flank.

other_distinctive_markers: The cephalic region anterior to the gill slits exhibits a high-density cluster of micro-blobs, significantly smaller in diameter compared to the primary flank constellation.
